description: Marks multiple tickets as spam in Zendesk. This action is irreversible — the tickets will be marked as spam and moved to the suspended tickets queue. The submitter will also be marked as spam and blocked from submitting further tickets. Use when cleaning up spam or unwanted tickets to protect your support queue. Returns a job_status payload for tracking the bulk operation. Note: Tickets marked as spam are moved to the suspended tickets queue and cannot be recovered through normal means.
